#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""ravenline nightly upload snapshot job."""
import json
import shutil
import tarfile
from pathlib import Path

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent


def main():
    conf = json.loads((BASE / "config" / "settings.json").read_text())
    src = BASE / conf["source_dir"]
    archive = BASE / ("snapshot-" + conf["schedule"].replace(":", "") + ".tar.gz")
    with tarfile.open(archive, "w:gz") as tar:
        tar.add(src, arcname="uploads")
    keep = sorted(BASE.glob("snapshot-*.tar.gz"))[: -conf["keep_versions"]]
    for old in keep:
        old.unlink()
    shutil.copy(archive, conf["target"])
    print("packed", src.name)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
